title: Final State After A
description: Essential Criteria: The state of the system after measuring observable A must be correctly identified as psi_1.

title: Probabilities for B
description: Important Criteria: The possible outcomes for observable B and their respective probabilities must be correctly calculated.

title: Probability Calculation for A
description: Essential Criteria: The probability of measuring a_1 after measuring B must be accurately computed.

title: Eigenstate Relationships
description: Important Criteria: The relationships between the eigenstates of A and B should be correctly established.

title: Normalization Check
description: Optional Criteria: A check to ensure that the eigenstates are normalized could be included.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Errors in calculating probabilities or misidentifying eigenstates will lead to a deduction.
